title: Come As You Are
speaker: Pastor Wayne Holcomb
description: Jesus didn't wait for the woman at the well to clean herself up before He spoke to her. He met her right where she was — and that's exactly what He does for every one of us. This week, Pastor Wayne explores what it means to come to Jesus exactly as you are, no performance required.

title: Roots That Hold
speaker: Pastor Wayne Holcomb
description: The trees that survive the storm aren't the tallest — they're the ones with the deepest roots. Pastor Wayne looks at what it means to plant yourself in God's Word and what that kind of rootedness produces in your life, your family, and your community.

title: The God Who Restores
speaker: Pastor Wayne Holcomb
description: There are things in all of our lives that have been lost — years, relationships, hope. But Joel 2:25 carries one of the most remarkable promises in all of Scripture: 'I will restore to you the years the locusts have eaten.' Pastor Wayne preaches on God's supernatural ability to redeem what we thought was gone forever.

title: Where Two or Three
speaker: Pastor Wayne Holcomb
description: God doesn't require a full stadium. Some of the most powerful moments of His presence have happened in the smallest rooms with the simplest prayers. This message is about the power of community prayer and why what happens in a small Georgia church on a Wednesday night matters to the Kingdom of God.

title: Good News for Ordinary People
speaker: Pastor Wayne Holcomb
description: The angels didn't announce the birth of Jesus to kings or priests. They appeared to shepherds — ordinary people, doing ordinary work in an ordinary field. The gospel has always been for people just like us. Pastor Wayne explores what it means that Jesus came for the everyday, the overlooked, and the ordinary.

title: Known by Name
speaker: Pastor Wayne Holcomb
description: The Good Shepherd calls His sheep by name — not by number, not by type, not by how well they've behaved. By name. Pastor Wayne preaches on what it means to be personally known and loved by a God who counts every hair on your head.
